name: commit0

rules.outcome_y: y_c = correct (passed hidden tests) programs whose frozen label is a non-default catalogue algorithm / N rows of the cell (invalid and 'other' count as not-target); attempted share = non-default catalogue labels / N (pass or fail) reported beside it
rules.fork_detection: per base path: outcome series k_t (continuations whose opening-classifier label differs from the base path's class) / n_t at t in {0,4,...,60} inside the program, S = 8, CRN keys (task, 'fork', base_path_id, t, i); exp31 fork.change_points (exhaustive binomial segmentation, <= 2 change points, 1000-permutation null), significant if p < 0.01; pooled per class; a change between t1 and t1+4 is localised by sampling t1+1..t1+3 at S = 8 and confirmed at S = 20 at f, f-1 and controls f-8, f+8
rules.fork_set: f_1 = first change position on default paths (the shared opening o_t before it = modal default token sequence); a later change point along the default path that separates another non-default class is added as f_2 (multi-fork rule, at most 3 forks); no change in 64 tokens -> window 128 (every 8th token, 2 paths per class); still none -> the task's margin is the 48-token LLR
rules.token_map: q_j(tok) = share of continuations starting with token tok at fork f_j whose final opening label is non-default, pooled over the S = 20 confirmation runs (and screen runs at f_j) of all base paths; tokens seen < 3 times are unmapped
rules.margin: e_j = sum_tok p(tok) q_j(tok) / sum_{mapped} p(tok) from one teacher-forced pass over [prompt_v + cell prefill edit] + o_t[0:f_J]; P_esc = 1 - prod_j (1 - e_j); Pbar_c = equal-weight mean over templates (per sample for per-sample-edit cells); m_c = log Pbar_c - log(1 - Pbar_c) (nats)
rules.axis_layer: a_L = unit(mean_i mean_j (h_forced_i[L,j] - h_pad_i[L,j])) over runner-up forced paraphrases (prompts4 named F0-F9, display-name variant 0) and their ' .' padding twins; leave-one-out sep(L) = mean_i d_i / sd_i d_i of the held-out S-mean projection difference; L_ax = argmax over 12..35 (ties -> smaller L); max sep < 2 -> L_ax = 20
rules.predictors: (b)_L = mean_v mean_j delta_v(L,j).a_L / Dbar(L) (signed, in default-to-runner-up units); (a) = mean_v ||U4^T dbar_v||^2/||dbar_v||^2 at L_ax; pi_Pt = mean_v ||P_t^T dbar_v||^2/||dbar_v||^2; norm = mean_v ||dbar_v(L_ax)||; delta_v = h_push - h_twin at spec positions (push_spec, ban_unit, alpha 2, blocks 12-23, prefill only); no outcome data
rules.F_test: within-task Spearman(m, y) over the 40 POP alpha-2 cells, direction-permutation p (10,000); pooled within-task rho (Pearson of within-task ranks); tie ceiling rho_max reported; held-out logistic calibration MAE over 10 half-splits stratified by task x cell family (all cells); thresholds: rho >= 0.5 on each task, pooled >= 0.6, p < 0.01, mean held-out MAE <= 0.10; disconfirming rho < 0.4 on both
rules.P2_test: Spearman((b)_L_ax, y) per task with permutation p; paired bootstrap (10,000 direction resamples) of rho_b - rho_X for X in {pi_Pt, norm, (a)}, 'ahead' = lower 95% bound > 0 for all three; thresholds rho_b >= 0.5 on T10 and T2, p < 0.01, ahead of all three; disconfirming rho_b < 0.2
rules.holm: Holm over {F, P2} within this artifact; raw p exported for the run-level Holm
rules.t03_confirmation: 24 fresh directions 97001-97024, N = 10 (W1-W5 x k 0,1), alpha 2, absolute T03 unit; committed (b) and m vs y, one-sided permutation p, no refit; < 3 directions with y > 0 -> uninformative (escape count and AUC reported)
rules.targeted_push: single-layer edit at L_ax, spec positions, prefill only: h <- h + (s D(L_ax,j) - (h - h_twin).a) a, s in {0.1,0.25,0.5,1}, N = 30 (W1-W5 x k 0-5); matched random r_t = rand_dir(98001 + task index) with the same per-position magnitudes |s D|; escape = correct runner-up share - twin >= 0.20, exact one-sided binomial p < 0.05 vs the twin's off-default rate, pass >= 0.8 x twin pass; pass if the smallest escaping s has rho_s <= 0.25 and the runner-up holds >= half of correct off-default programs on >= 2 tasks; CRN McNemar axis vs random at each s
rules.clamp: 4 confirmed escapers with the largest y per task (T10, T2), N = 20 own CRN slots, clamp h <- h - ((h - h_twin).a_L) a_L at blocks L_ax..35 spec positions after the push; control: matched random unit direction; necessity supported if the axis clamp removes >= 50% of escapes and the random clamp <= 15%
rules.top5: T1 band edit blocks 12-23, per position: Delta_l[j] = c_surv[l,j] - c_ban[l,j] (c_ban = mean of the five banned algorithms' forced centroids), u = unit(Delta_l[j]); h <- h + (s||Delta_l[j]|| - (h - h_twin).u)u; arms SURV (survivor-region centroid = mean of five survivor centroids), AWAY (u = unit(h_twin - c_ban)), RSURV (survivor X uniform per slot, seed stable_seed('T1','RSURV',w,k)), IDASTAR (s 0.5) at s in {0.25,0.5,1}, N = 30; landing scored on Isomap (k 5/10/15) geodesics of forced-prompt S-mean points: 'edge' survivors = g(X) <= median; landing score = share of correct non-TOP5 programs on edge survivors
rules.blindness: no POP_* outcome row (label, passed, code, text) of exp29 is opened before commit #3; common.guarded_e29_rows refuses them until predictions/commit3_predictors.json exists
stage_order: Stage 0 (twins, 5 POP directions unlabelled, realised norms)
